plan.notes: University of Denver is on the quarter system (Fall/Winter/Spring); term_system=quarter. Official sample 4-year course plan ('BA in Criminology') from the 2025-2026 Undergraduate Bulletin Sociology and Criminology program PDF (12 quarters). Plan states Total Credits: 190; declared total 190; term totals (Y1 16/16/16, Y2 16/14/16, Y3 16/16/16, Y4 16/16/16) reconcile exactly. 'Major 2' is the bulletin's label for second-major courses, encoded as choice slots exactly as the official plan lists them. Generic slots (language/SI sequences, AI/SI requirements, criminology electives, electives, study-abroad block, Advanced Seminar) encoded as choice slots; no courses invented. BA requires 183 credits for the degree; criminology major requires 40 credits (SOCI 1810, 2020, 2005, 2006, 2250 plus 20 credits of electives; SOCI 3998 Criminology Assessment is a 0-credit major requirement not shown in the sample schedule). Program note: students may not double-major, double-minor, or major-minor in both sociology and criminology. Footnote: INTZ 2501 is required for any student who studies abroad and may be taken in any quarter within the year prior to studying abroad.
